verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ τὸν Ἀπολλῶ εἶναι ἐν Κορίνθῳ Παῦλον διελθόντα τὰ ἀνωτερικὰ μέρη ἐλθεῖν εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εὑρεῖν τινας μαθητάς
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de en tō ton Apollō einai en Korinthō Paulon dielthonta ta anōterika merē elthein eis Epheson kai heurein tinas mathētas
verses.literal: While Apollos was at Corinth Paul passed through the interior . . . and came to Ephesus There he found some disciples

verses.original: εἶπέν τε πρὸς αὐτούς Εἰ Πνεῦμα Ἅγιον ἐλάβετε πιστεύσαντες Οἱ δὲ πρὸς αὐτόν Ἀλλ’ οὐδ’ εἰ Πνεῦμα Ἅγιον ἔστιν ἠκούσαμεν
verses.transliteration: eipen te pros autous Ei Pneuma Hagion elabete pisteusantes Hoi de pros auton All’ oud’ ei Pneuma Hagion estin ēkousamen
verses.literal: and asked them Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you became believers No they answered . . . . . . . . . we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit

verses.original: Εἶπέν τε Εἰς τί οὖν ἐβαπτίσθητε Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Εἰς τὸ Ἰωάννου βάπτισμα
verses.transliteration: Eipen te Eis ti oun ebaptisthēte Hoi de eipan Eis to Iōannou baptisma
verses.literal: Into what then were you baptized Paul asked The baptism of John - they replied

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ Παῦλος Ἰωάννης ἐβάπτισεν βάπτισμα μετανοίας τῷ λαῷ λέγων εἰς τὸν ἐρχόμενον μετ’ αὐτὸν ἵνα πιστεύσωσιν τοῦτ’ ἔστιν εἰς τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Eipen de Paulos Iōannēs ebaptisen baptisma metanoias tō laō legōn eis ton erchomenon met’ auton hina pisteusōsin tout’ estin eis ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: Paul explained John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance He told the people to believe in the One coming after him that is in Jesus

verses.original: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ ἐβαπτίσθησαν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Akousantes de ebaptisthēsan eis to onoma tou Kyriou Iēsou
verses.literal: On hearing this they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus

verses.original: καὶ ἐπιθέντος αὐτοῖς τοῦ Παύλου τὰς χεῖρας ἦλθε τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ἐπ’ αὐτούς ἐλάλουν τε γλώσσαις καὶ ἐπροφήτευον
verses.transliteration: kai epithentos autois tou Paulou tas cheiras ēlthe to Pneuma to Hagion ep’ autous elaloun te glōssais kai eprophēteuon
verses.literal: And when Paul laid his hands on them the Holy Spirit came upon them and they spoke in tongues and prophesied

verses.original: ἦσαν δὲ οἱ πάντες ἄνδρες ὡσεὶ δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: ēsan de hoi pantes andres hōsei dōdeka
verses.literal: There were about twelve men in all

verses.original: Εἰσελθὼν δὲ εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐπαρρησιάζετο ἐπὶ μῆνας τρεῖς διαλεγόμενος καὶ πείθων τὰ περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eiselthōn de eis tēn synagōgēn eparrēsiazeto epi mēnas treis dialegomenos kai peithōn ta peri tēs basileias tou Theou
verses.literal: Then Paul went into the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God

verses.original: ὡς δέ τινες ἐσκληρύνοντο καὶ ἠπείθουν κακολογοῦντες τὴν Ὁδὸν ἐνώπιον τοῦ πλήθους ἀποστὰς ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ἀφώρισεν τοὺς μαθητάς καθ’ ἡμέραν διαλεγόμενος ἐν τῇ σχολῇ Τυράννου
verses.transliteration: hōs de tines esklērynonto kai ēpeithoun kakologountes tēn Hodon enōpion tou plēthous apostas ap’ autōn aphōrisen tous mathētas kath’ hēmeran dialegomenos en tē scholē Tyrannou
verses.literal: But when some of them stubbornly refused to believe and publicly maligned the Way Paul took his disciples and left . . . the synagogue to conduct daily discussions . . . . . . in the lecture hall of Tyrannus

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ ἔτη δύο ὥστε πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν Ἀσίαν ἀκοῦσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰουδαίους τε καὶ Ἕλληνας
verses.transliteration: touto de egeneto epi etē dyo hōste pantas tous katoikountas tēn Asian akousai ton logon tou Kyriou Ioudaious te kai Hellēnas
verses.literal: This continued for two years so that everyone who lived in the province of Asia Jews and Greeks alike heard the word of the Lord

verses.original: Δυνάμεις τε οὐ τὰς τυχούσας ὁ Θεὸς ἐποίει διὰ τῶν χειρῶν Παύλου
verses.transliteration: Dynameis te ou tas tychousas ho Theos epoiei dia tōn cheirōn Paulou
verses.literal: God did extraordinary miracles through the hands of Paul

verses.original: ὥστε καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀσθενοῦντας ἀποφέρεσθαι ἀπὸ τοῦ χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ σουδάρια ἢ σιμικίνθια καὶ ἀπαλλάσσεσθαι ἀπ’ αὐτῶν τὰς νόσους τά τε πνεύματα τὰ πονηρὰ ἐκπορεύεσθαι
verses.transliteration: hōste kai epi tous asthenountas apopheresthai apo tou chrōtos autou soudaria ē simikinthia kai apallassesthai ap’ autōn tas nosous ta te pneumata ta ponēra ekporeuesthai
verses.literal: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick and the diseases and - evil spirits left . . . them

verses.original: Ἐπεχείρησαν δέ τινες καὶ τῶν περιερχομένων Ἰουδαίων ἐξορκιστῶν ὀνομάζειν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἔχοντας τὰ πνεύματα τὰ πονηρὰ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες Ὁρκίζω ὑμᾶς τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὃν Παῦλος κηρύσσει
verses.transliteration: Epecheirēsan de tines kai tōn perierchomenōn Ioudaiōn exorkistōn onomazein epi tous echontas ta pneumata ta ponēra to onoma tou Kyriou Iēsou legontes Horkizō hymas ton Iēsoun hon Paulos kēryssei
verses.literal: Now there were some itinerant Jewish exorcists who tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those with evil spirits They would say I command you by Jesus whom Paul proclaims

verses.original: ἦσαν δέ τινος Σκευᾶ Ἰουδαίου ἀρχιερέως ἑπτὰ υἱοὶ τοῦτο ποιοῦντες
verses.transliteration: ēsan de tinos Skeua Ioudaiou archiereōs hepta huioi touto poiountes
verses.literal: Seven sons of Sceva a Jewish chief priest were doing this

verses.original: ἀποκριθὲν δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πονηρὸν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τὸν Μὲν Ἰησοῦν γινώσκω καὶ τὸν Παῦλον ἐπίσταμαι ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνες ἐστέ
verses.transliteration: apokrithen de to pneuma to ponēron eipen autois Ton Men Iēsoun ginōskō kai ton Paulon epistamai hymeis de tines este
verses.literal: But one day the evil spirit responded . . . . . . - Jesus I know and I know about Paul but who are you

verses.original: καὶ ἐφαλόμενος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἐν ᾧ ἦν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πονηρὸν κατακυριεύσας ἀμφοτέρων ἴσχυσεν κατ’ αὐτῶν ὥστε γυμνοὺς καὶ τετραυματισμένους ἐκφυγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου ἐκείνου
verses.transliteration: kai ephalomenos ho anthrōpos ep’ autous en hō ēn to pneuma to ponēron katakyrieusas amphoterōn ischysen kat’ autōn hōste gymnous kai tetraumatismenous ekphygein ek tou oikou ekeinou
verses.literal: Then the man with . . . the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all The attack . . . . . . was so violent that they ran out of the house naked and wounded

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο γνωστὸν πᾶσιν Ἰουδαίοις τε καὶ Ἕλλησιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν τὴν Ἔφεσον καὶ ἐπέπεσεν φόβος ἐπὶ πάντας αὐτούς καὶ ἐμεγαλύνετο τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Touto de egeneto gnōston pasin Ioudaiois te kai Hellēsin tois katoikousin tēn Epheson kai epepesen phobos epi pantas autous kai emegalyneto to onoma tou Kyriou Iēsou
verses.literal: This became known to all the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus and fear came over all of them So the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor

verses.original: πολλοί τε τῶν πεπιστευκότων ἤρχοντο ἐξομολογούμενοι καὶ ἀναγγέλλοντες τὰς πράξεις αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: polloi te tōn pepisteukotōn ērchonto exomologoumenoi kai anangellontes tas praxeis autōn
verses.literal: Many who had believed now came forward confessing and disclosing their deeds

verses.original: ἱκανοὶ δὲ τῶν τὰ περίεργα πραξάντων συνενέγκαντες τὰς βίβλους κατέκαιον ἐνώπιον πάντων καὶ συνεψήφισαν τὰς τιμὰς αὐτῶν καὶ εὗρον ἀργυρίου μυριάδας πέντε
verses.transliteration: hikanoi de tōn ta perierga praxantōn synenenkantes tas biblous katekaion enōpion pantōn kai synepsēphisan tas timas autōn kai heuron argyriou myriadas pente
verses.literal: And a number of those who had practiced magic arts brought their books and burned them in front of everyone When the value of the books was calculated the total came to fifty thousand . . . drachmas

verses.original: Οὕτως κατὰ κράτος τοῦ Κυρίου ὁ λόγος ηὔξανεν καὶ ἴσχυεν
verses.transliteration: Houtōs kata kratos tou Kyriou ho logos ēuxanen kai ischyen
verses.literal: So the word of the Lord powerfully continued to spread and prevail

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἐπληρώθη ταῦτα ἔθετο ὁ Παῦλος ἐν τῷ πνεύματι διελθὼν τὴν Μακεδονίαν καὶ Ἀχαΐαν πορεύεσθαι εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα εἰπὼν ὅτι Μετὰ τὸ γενέσθαι με ἐκεῖ δεῖ με καὶ Ῥώμην ἰδεῖν
verses.transliteration: Hōs de eplērōthē tauta etheto ho Paulos en tō pneumati dielthōn tēn Makedonian kai Achaian poreuesthai eis Hierosolyma eipōn hoti Meta to genesthai me ekei dei me kai Rhōmēn idein
verses.literal: After these things had happened Paul resolved in the Spirit to go to Jerusalem passing through Macedonia and Achaia After I have been there he said I must see Rome as well

verses.original: ἀποστείλας δὲ εἰς τὴν Μακεδονίαν δύο τῶν διακονούντων αὐτῷ Τιμόθεον καὶ Ἔραστον αὐτὸς ἐπέσχεν χρόνον εἰς τὴν Ἀσίαν
verses.transliteration: aposteilas de eis tēn Makedonian dyo tōn diakonountōn autō Timotheon kai Eraston autos epeschen chronon eis tēn Asian
verses.literal: He sent two of his helpers Timothy and Erastus to Macedonia while he stayed for a time in the province of Asia

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν ἐκεῖνον τάραχος οὐκ ὀλίγος περὶ τῆς Ὁδοῦ
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de kata ton kairon ekeinon tarachos ouk oligos peri tēs Hodou
verses.literal: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way

verses.original: Δημήτριος γάρ τις ὀνόματι ἀργυροκόπος ποιῶν ναοὺς ἀργυροῦς Ἀρτέμιδος παρείχετο τοῖς τεχνίταις οὐκ ὀλίγην ἐργασίαν
verses.transliteration: Dēmētrios gar tis onomati argyrokopos poiōn naous argyrous Artemidos pareicheto tois technitais ouk oligēn ergasian
verses.literal: It began with a silversmith named Demetrius who made silver shrines of Artemis bringing much business to the craftsmen

verses.original: οὓς συναθροίσας καὶ τοὺς περὶ τὰ τοιαῦτα ἐργάτας εἶπεν Ἄνδρες ἐπίστασθε ὅτι ἐκ ταύτης τῆς ἐργασίας ἡ εὐπορία ἡμῖν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: hous synathroisas kai tous peri ta toiauta ergatas eipen Andres epistasthe hoti ek tautēs tēs ergasias hē euporia hēmin estin
verses.literal: Demetrius assembled the craftsmen along with the workmen in related trades Men he said you know that this business is our source of prosperity

verses.original: καὶ θεωρεῖτε καὶ ἀκούετε ὅτι οὐ μόνον Ἐφέσου ἀλλὰ σχεδὸν πάσης τῆς Ἀσίας ὁ Παῦλος οὗτος πείσας μετέστησεν ἱκανὸν ὄχλον λέγων ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν θεοὶ οἱ διὰ χειρῶν γινόμενοι
verses.transliteration: kai theōreite kai akouete hoti ou monon Ephesou alla schedon pasēs tēs Asias ho Paulos houtos peisas metestēsen hikanon ochlon legōn hoti ouk eisin theoi hoi dia cheirōn ginomenoi
verses.literal: And you can see and hear that not only in Ephesus but in nearly the whole province of Asia this Paul has persuaded a great number of people to turn away He says that man-made gods . . . . . . are no gods at all

verses.original: οὐ μόνον δὲ τοῦτο κινδυνεύει ἡμῖν τὸ μέρος εἰς ἀπελεγμὸν ἐλθεῖν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸ τῆς μεγάλης θεᾶς Ἀρτέμιδος ἱερὸν εἰς οὐθὲν λογισθῆναι μέλλειν τε καὶ καθαιρεῖσθαι τῆς μεγαλειότητος αὐτῆς ἣν ὅλη ἡ Ἀσία καὶ ἡ οἰκουμένη σέβεται
verses.transliteration: ou monon de touto kindyneuei hēmin to meros eis apelegmon elthein alla kai to tēs megalēs theas Artemidos hieron eis outhen logisthēnai mellein te kai kathaireisthai tēs megaleiotētos autēs hēn holē hē Asia kai hē oikoumenē sebetai
verses.literal: There is danger not only that our business will fall into disrepute but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited . . . . . . and her majesty deposed she who is worshiped by all the province of Asia and the whole world

verses.original: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ καὶ γενόμενοι πλήρεις θυμοῦ ἔκραζον λέγοντες Μεγάλη ἡ Ἄρτεμις Ἐφεσίων
verses.transliteration: Akousantes de kai genomenoi plēreis thymou ekrazon legontes Megalē hē Artemis Ephesiōn
verses.literal: When the men heard this they were enraged and began shouting . . . Great is Artemis of the Ephesians

verses.original: καὶ ἐπλήσθη ἡ πόλις τῆς συγχύσεως ὥρμησάν τε ὁμοθυμαδὸν εἰς τὸ θέατρον συναρπάσαντες Γάϊον καὶ Ἀρίσταρχον Μακεδόνας συνεκδήμους Παύλου
verses.transliteration: kai eplēsthē hē polis tēs synchyseōs hōrmēsan te homothymadon eis to theatron synarpasantes Gaion kai Aristarchon Makedonas synekdēmous Paulou
verses.literal: Soon the whole city was in disarray They rushed together into the theatre dragging with them Gaius and Aristarchus Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia

verses.original: Παύλου δὲ βουλομένου εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν δῆμον οὐκ εἴων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταί
verses.transliteration: Paulou de boulomenou eiselthein eis ton dēmon ouk eiōn auton hoi mathētai
verses.literal: Paul wanted to go before . . . the assembly but the disciples would not allow him

verses.original: τινὲς δὲ καὶ τῶν Ἀσιαρχῶν ὄντες αὐτῷ φίλοι πέμψαντες πρὸς αὐτὸν παρεκάλουν μὴ δοῦναι ἑαυτὸν εἰς τὸ θέατρον
verses.transliteration: tines de kai tōn Asiarchōn ontes autō philoi pempsantes pros auton parekaloun mē dounai heauton eis to theatron
verses.literal: Even some of Paul’s friends who were officials of the province of Asia sent word to him begging him not to venture into the theatre

verses.original: Ἄλλοι μὲν οὖν ἄλλο τι ἔκραζον ἦν γὰρ ἡ ἐκκλησία συγκεχυμένη καὶ οἱ πλείους οὐκ ᾔδεισαν τίνος ἕνεκα συνεληλύθεισαν
verses.transliteration: Alloi men oun allo ti ekrazon ēn gar hē ekklēsia synkechymenē kai hoi pleious ouk ēdeisan tinos heneka synelēlytheisan
verses.literal: Meanwhile . . . . . . the assembly was in turmoil Some were shouting one thing and some another and most of them did not even know why . . . they were there

verses.original: ἐκ δὲ τοῦ ὄχλου συνεβίβασαν Ἀλέξανδρον προβαλόντων αὐτὸν τῶν Ἰουδαίων ὁ δὲ Ἀλέξανδρος κατασείσας τὴν χεῖρα ἤθελεν ἀπολογεῖσθαι τῷ δήμῳ
verses.transliteration: ek de tou ochlou synebibasan Alexandron probalontōn auton tōn Ioudaiōn ho de Alexandros kataseisas tēn cheira ēthelen apologeisthai tō dēmō
verses.literal: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander forward to explain himself and he motioned for silence . . . . . . so he could make his defense to the people

verses.original: ἐπιγνόντες δὲ ὅτι Ἰουδαῖός ἐστιν φωνὴ ἐγένετο μία ἐκ πάντων ὡς ἐπὶ ὥρας δύο κραζόντων Μεγάλη ἡ Ἄρτεμις Ἐφεσίων
verses.transliteration: epignontes de hoti Ioudaios estin phōnē egeneto mia ek pantōn hōs epi hōras dyo krazontōn Megalē hē Artemis Ephesiōn
verses.literal: But when they realized that he was a Jew they all shouted in unison . . . . . . . . . . . . for about two hours Great is Artemis of the Ephesians

verses.original: Καταστείλας δὲ ὁ γραμματεὺς τὸν ὄχλον φησίν Ἄνδρες Ἐφέσιοι τίς γάρ ἐστιν ἀνθρώπων ὃς οὐ γινώσκει τὴν Ἐφεσίων πόλιν νεωκόρον οὖσαν τῆς μεγάλης Ἀρτέμιδος καὶ τοῦ διοπετοῦς
verses.transliteration: Katasteilas de ho grammateus ton ochlon phēsin Andres Ephesioi tis gar estin anthrōpōn hos ou ginōskei tēn Ephesiōn polin neōkoron ousan tēs megalēs Artemidos kai tou diopetous
verses.literal: Finally the city clerk quieted the crowd and declared Men of Ephesus doesn’t . . . everyone . . . know that the city of Ephesus is guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image which fell from heaven

verses.original: ἀναντιρρήτων οὖν ὄντων τούτων δέον ἐστὶν ὑμᾶς κατεσταλμένους ὑπάρχειν καὶ μηδὲν προπετὲς πράσσειν
verses.transliteration: anantirrētōn oun ontōn toutōn deon estin hymas katestalmenous hyparchein kai mēden propetes prassein
verses.literal: Since these things are undeniable you ought to be calm and not do anything rash

verses.original: ἠγάγετε γὰρ τοὺς ἄνδρας τούτους οὔτε ἱεροσύλους οὔτε βλασφημοῦντας τὴν θεὸν ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: ēgagete gar tous andras toutous oute hierosylous oute blasphēmountas tēn theon hēmōn
verses.literal: For you have brought these men here though they have neither robbed our temple nor blasphemed our goddess

verses.original: Εἰ μὲν οὖν Δημήτριος καὶ οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ τεχνῖται ἔχουσι πρός τινα λόγον ἀγοραῖοι ἄγονται καὶ ἀνθύπατοί εἰσιν ἐγκαλείτωσαν ἀλλήλοις
verses.transliteration: Ei men oun Dēmētrios kai hoi syn autō technitai echousi pros tina logon agoraioi agontai kai anthypatoi eisin enkaleitōsan allēlois
verses.literal: So if Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a complaint against anyone the courts are open and proconsuls are available Let them bring charges against one another there

verses.original: εἰ δέ τι περαιτέρω ἐπιζητεῖτε ἐν τῇ ἐννόμῳ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἐπιλυθήσεται
verses.transliteration: ei de ti peraiterō epizēteite en tē ennomō ekklēsia epilythēsetai
verses.literal: But if you are seeking anything beyond this it must be settled in a legal assembly

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ κινδυνεύομεν ἐγκαλεῖσθαι στάσεως περὶ τῆς σήμερον μηδενὸς αἰτίου ὑπάρχοντος περὶ οὗ οὐ δυνησόμεθα ἀποδοῦναι λόγον περὶ τῆς συστροφῆς ταύτης
verses.transliteration: kai gar kindyneuomen enkaleisthai staseōs peri tēs sēmeron mēdenos aitiou hyparchontos peri hou ou dynēsometha apodounai logon peri tēs systrophēs tautēs
verses.literal: For we are in jeopardy of being charged with rioting for today’s events and we have . . . no justification . . . to account for this commotion

verses.original: Καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν ἀπέλυσεν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai tauta eipōn apelysen tēn ekklēsian
verses.literal: After he had said this he dismissed the assembly
